question_text:
12.  Solar Tech is considering expanding into a developing country where electricity
access is low. Which external factor is the primary reason for this decision?
(A)  Low production costs in the target country
(B)  Strong competition from global solar brands
(C)  Availability of skilled solar engineers
(D)  High demand for alternative energy sources
(2 Marks)
